sn35.95:1.1: kho āyasmā Mālukyaputto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mālukyaputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpi pahitatto vihareyyanti || ||
sn35.95:2.1: Ettha dāni Mālukyaputta kiṃ dahare bhikkhū vakkhāma || yatrahi nāma tvam bhikkhu jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto saṃkhittena ovādaṃ yācasīti || ||
sn35.95:3.1: Kiñcāpaham bhante jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto desetu me bhante Bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu Sugato saṃkhittena dhammaṃ || appevanāmahaṃ Bhagavato bhāsitassa attham ājāneyyaṃ || appevanāmaham Bhagavato bhāsitassa dāyādo assanti || ||
sn35.95:4.1: Tam kim maññasi Mālukyaputta || || Ye te cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā adiṭṭhā adiṭṭhapubbā na ca passasi || na ca te hoti Passeyyanti || atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti || || No hetam bhante || ||
sn35.95:5.1: Ye te sotaviññeyyā saddā assutā assutāpabbā na ca suṇāsi || na ca te hoti Suṇeyyanti || atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemanti || || No hetam bhante || ||
sn35.95:6.1: Ye te ghānaviññeyyā ganadhā aghāyitā aghāyitapubbā na ca ghāyasi || na ca te hoti Ghāyeyyanti || atthi te tattha || la || || Ye te jivhāviññeyyā rasā asāyitā asāyitapubbā
sn35.95:7.1: na ca sāyasi || na ca te hoti Sāyeyyanti || atthi te tattha || la || || Yetekāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā asamphuṭṭhā
sn35.95:8.1: asampuṭṭhapubbā na ca phusasi || na ca te hoti Phuseyyanti || atthi te tattha || la || || Ye te manoviññeyyā dhammā aviññātā aviññātapubbā
sn35.95:9.1: na ca vijānāsi || na ca te hoti vijāneyyanti || atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti || || No hetam bhante || ||
sn35.95:10.1: Ettha ca te Mālukyaputta diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati || sute sutamattam bhavissati || mute mutamattam bhavissati || viññāte viññātamuttam bhavissati || || Yato kho te Mālukyaputta diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattam bhavissati || sute sutamattam bhavissati || mute mutamattam bhavissati || viññāte viññātamattam bhavissati || tato tvam Mālukyaputta na tena || || Yato tvam Mālukyaputta na tena || tato tvam Mālukyaputta na tattha || || Yato tvam Mālukyaputta na tattha || tato tvam Mālukyaputta nevidha na huram na ubhayamantarena || esevanto dukkhassāti || ||
sn35.95:11.1: Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāmi || ||
sn35.95:12.1: Rūpaṃ disvā sati muṭṭhā || piyanimittam manasi karoto || sārattacitto vedeti || tañca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:13.1: Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā || anekā rūpasambhavā || abhijjhā ca vihesā ca || cittam assu pahaññati || || Evam ācinato dukkhaṃ || ārā nibbānaṃ vuccati || ||
sn35.95:14.1: Saddaṃ sutvā sati muṭṭhā || piyanimittam manasi karoto || sārattacitto vedeti || tañca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:15.1: Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā || anekā saddasambhavā || abhijjhā ca vihesā ca || cittam assu pahaññati || || Evam ācinato dukkhaṃ || ārā nibbānaṃ vuccati || ||
sn35.95:16.1: Gandhaṃ ghātvā sati muṭṭhā || piyanimittam manasi karoto || sārattacitto vedeti || tañca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:17.1: Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā || anekā gandhasambhavā || abhijjhā ca vihesā ca || cittam assu pahaññati || Evam ācinato dukkhaṃ || ārā nibbānaṃ vuccati || ||
sn35.95:18.1: Rasam bhotvā sati muṭṭhā || piyanimittam manasi karoto || sārattacitto vedeti || tañca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:19.1: Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā || anekā rasasambhavā || la || ārā nibbānaṃ vuccati || ||
sn35.95:20.1: Phassam phussa sati muṭṭhā || piyanimittam manasi karoto || sārattacitto vedeti || tañca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:21.1: Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā || anekā phassasambhavā || la || ārā nibbānaṃ vuccati || ||
sn35.95:22.1: Dhammaṃ ñatvā sati muṭṭhā || piyanimittaṃ manasi karoto || sārattacitto vedeti || tañca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.95:23.1: Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā || anekā dhammasambhavā || abhijjhā ca vihesā ca || cittam assu pahaññati || Evam ācinato dukkham || ārā nibbānam vuccati || ||
sn35.95:24.1: Na so rajjati rūpesu || rūpaṃ disvā patissato || virattacitto vedeti || tañca nājjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:25.1: Yathāssa passato rūpaṃ || sevato cāpi vedanaṃ || khīyati no pacīyati || evaṃ so carati sato || || Evam apacinato dukkhaṃ || santike nibbānaṃ vuccati || ||
sn35.95:26.1: Na so rajjati saddesu || saddaṃ sutvā patissato || virattacitto vedeti || tañca nājjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:27.1: Yathāssa suṇato saddaṃ || sevato cāpi vedanaṃ || khīyati no pacīyati || evam so carati sato || Evam apacinato dukkhaṃ || santike nibbānaṃvuccati || ||
sn35.95:28.1: Na so rajjati gandhesu || gandhaṃ ghātvā patissato || virattacitto vedeti || tañca na cājjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:29.1: Yathāssa ghāyato gandhaṃ || secato cāpi vedanaṃ || khīyati no pacīyati || evaṃ so carati sato || || Evam apacinato dukkhaṃ || santike nibbāna vuccati || ||
sn35.95:30.1: Na so rajjati rasesu || rasam bhotvā patissato || virattacitto vedeti || tañca nājjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:31.1: Yathāssa sāyato rasaṃ || sevato cāpi vedanaṃ || || pa || santike nibbānaṃ vuccati || ||
sn35.95:32.1: Na so rajjati phassesu || phassamphussa patissato || virattacitto vedeti || taṃ ca nājjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:33.1: Yathāssa phusato phassaṃ || sevato cāpi vedanaṃ || || pa || santike nibbānaṃ vuccati || ||
sn35.95:34.1: Na so rajjati dhammesu || dhammaṃ ñatvā patissato || virattacitto vedeti || tañca nājjhosa tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.95:35.1: Yathāssa vijānato dhammaṃ || sevato cāpi vedanaṃ || khīyati no pacīyati || {evaṃ} so carati sato || || Evam apacinato dukkhaṃ || santike nibbānaṃ vuccatī ti || ||
sn35.95:36.1: Imassa kho ham bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || || Sādhu sādhu Mālukyaputta || sādhu kho tvam Mālukyaputta mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || ||
sn35.95:37.1: Rūpaṃ disvā sati muṭṭhā || piyanimittam manasi karoto || sārattacitto vedeti || tañca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.95:38.1: Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā || anekā rūpasambhavā || abhijjhā ca vihesā ca || cittam assu pahaññati || Evam ācinato dukkham || ārā nibbānaṃ vuccati || || || pe ||
sn35.95:39.1: Na so rajjati dhammesu || dhammaṃ ñatvā patissato || virattacitto vedeti || taṃ ca nājjhosa tiṭṭhati || ||
sn35.95:40.1: Yathāssa vijānato dhammaṃ || sevato cāpi vedanaṃ || khīyati no pacīyati || evaṃ so carati sato || Evam apacinato dukkhaṃ || santike nibbānaṃ vuccatīti || ||
sn35.95:41.1: Imassa kho Mālukyaputta mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti || ||
sn35.95:42.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mālukyaputto Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || Atha kho āyasmā Mālukyaputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjanti tadanuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || || Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyam || nāparam itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi || || Aññataro ca panāyasmā Mālukyaputto arahataṃ ahosīti || ||
